feedback_tip_0: 💡 Binary Search Strategy: Try guessing %d (the exact midpoint of %d and %d) to instantly eliminate half the remaining search space.
feedback_tip_1: 💡 Range Analysis: The target number is strictly greater than the arithmetic mean (%d) of your current search bracket.
feedback_tip_2: 💡 Range Analysis: The target number is strictly less than the arithmetic mean (%d) of your current search bracket.
feedback_tip_3: 💡 Proportional Clue: Your last guess was off by %d units. The target is in the %s half of your active bounds.
feedback_tip_4: 💡 Parity Clue: The target number is %s (even/odd parity check).
feedback_tip_5: 💡 Divisibility Clue: The target number %s divisible by %d.
feedback_tip_6: 💡 Modular Arithmetic: The target number modulo 10 is %d.
feedback_tip_7: 💡 Distance Indicator: You are within %d units of the secret target number!
feedback_tip_8: 💡 Golden Ratio / Midpoint: The target lies in the %s quartile of your current range [%d - %d].
feedback_tip_9: 💡 Prime / Composite Check: The target number is %s.
feedback_tip_10: 💡 Digital Root: The sum of the digits of the target number equals %d.
feedback_tip_11: 💡 Logarithmic Bound: The target number's magnitude is in the %s range relative to your active span.
feedback_tip_12: 💡 Quadratic Clue: The target number is %s a perfect square.
feedback_tip_13: 💡 Interval Clue: The secret target resides precisely between %d and %d.

feedback_tip_15: 💡 Delta Vector: Your previous delta was %d. Converge toward the center of mass of your range.
feedback_tip_16: 💡 Binary Partition: Splitting the interval [%d, %d] yields a candidate test point at %d.
feedback_tip_17: 💡 Factor Analysis: The target shares a common factor divisor with %d.
feedback_tip_18: 💡 Inequality Check: The target number is %s than %d.
feedback_tip_19: 💡 Statistical Clue: Based on uniform random distribution across [%d, %d], the expected value is %d.
feedback_tip_20: 💡 Absolute Error: Your last attempt had an absolute variance of %d units from target.
feedback_tip_21: 💡 Permutation Clue: The tens digit of the target is %s than its units digit.
feedback_tip_22: 💡 Modular Congruence: The target is congruent to %d modulo 5.
feedback_tip_23: 💡 Bounding Box: The target is safely enclosed within sub-interval [%d, %d].
